name: Tanta
description: Peruvian restaurant inside Larcomar with ocean views. Known for aji de gallina, lomo saltado, and a lively atmosphere any day of the week.

name: Puku Puku - Larcomar
address: Mal. de la Reserva 610, Piso -3, Miraflores
description: Small specialty coffee shop tucked inside Larcomar mall, with one of the best ocean views in the area and carefully brewed coffee.

name: La Lucha Sangucheria Criolla
description: Iconic Lima sandwich counter famous for its chicharron sandwich and chicha morada. Always busy, fast service, classic Miraflores stop.

name: El Pan de la Chola - Dasso
description: Popular bakery-café known for artisan sourdough bread, pastries, and coffee roasted in-house. Pet friendly, great for a relaxed breakfast.

name: La Baguette - Armendáriz
description: Classic Miraflores café known for breakfasts, waffles, and French-style breads. Indoor and open-air seating available.

name: Ayni Coffee - Tarata
description: Cozy specialty coffee shop known for its desserts and the fun touch of giving customers a puzzle to solve while they wait.

name: Demo
description: Popular Barranco bakery-café known for its flan, pastries, and brunch dishes. Small space, gets busy on weekends.

name: Panea
description: Artisan bakery famous for its croissants and pastries. A popular breakfast stop in Miraflores, best visited for fresh croissants in the morning.

name: Milenaria Cafe
description: Cozy neighborhood café near Kennedy Park known for its lattes, avocado toast, and relaxed indoor and outdoor seating.

name: Quinoa Café
address: Av. Vasco Núñez de Balboa 785, Miraflores
description: Casual café with vegetarian and vegan-friendly options, fresh smoothies, and juices. Good wifi and a relaxed working atmosphere.

name: Las Bolena Tea Room & Restaurant
hours: Tue-Fri 12:00 PM - 11:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 11:00 PM, Sun 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM, closed Mon
description: Elegant tea room known for specialty desserts, a wide tea menu, and a cozy, detail-filled atmosphere. Great for brunch with friends.

name: Lucio Caffè - Santa Cruz
description: Warm, comfortable café known for its lunch menu, sandwiches, and frappuccinos. A favorite spot with Miraflores office workers.

name: Panchita - Miraflores
description: Well-known Peruvian grill restaurant famous for anticuchos, lomo saltado, and picarones. Busy and popular with locals and visitors alike.

name: Kauza Restaurante - Miraflores
description: Modern Peruvian restaurant specializing in creative causas and fresh ceviche, with rooftop seating and an English-friendly menu.

name: Dolce Capriccio
description: Beloved bakery and dessert shop famous for its cakes, tres leches, and gelato. A go-to stop for a sweet treat in Miraflores.
